ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels covering approximately 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to the distal tips and specific scar regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Lighter circular mottling observed in the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe; irregular high-intensity patches are concentrated along the upper margin of the right lobe near the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 25 degrees; depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge of both lobes; frequency of peaks increases toward the distal tips, with varying pixel-amplitudes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave sweep originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips, terminating in sharp, upward-oriented points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast white rosettes corresponding to barnacle colonization are located on the far-left and far-right distal tips and along the lower leading edges.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 3-4 parallel, diagonal high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) are visible on the upper section of the right lobe; similar but less distinct markings are visible on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations on distal tips and trailing edges; prominent parallel rake mark scars on the right lobe surface.
